dedupe_keys.name: smart company energy monitoring analysis and aggregation

description: Honda Research Institute Europe publishes Python code for analysing a company-building energy-monitoring dataset. The repository documents configuration files, meter identifiers, issue templates, aggregation and resampling. It also produces energy-flow Sankey diagrams, issue statistics and yearly figures, and checks relationships between power and energy measurements. Public source is free under BSD 3-Clause. The tool can prepare metered load and generation profiles before calibration of building simulations with model-energyplus or control optimization. A caveat is that its naming and configuration follow the associated site's meter network; a different building needs a meter map and adapted configuration. Generated diagrams do not by themselves prove data quality or energy balance. The README and repository licence were inspected, but dependencies, runtime behaviour and numerical results were not tested. The associated Dryad data are assessed separately.
